Question: How do I log in to the platform?
Answer: Sign in with your student email that ends in .bu.ac.th. Only that domain is accepted.

Question: My non-BU email won't work — why?
Answer: Login is restricted to student emails ending in .bu.ac.th. Use your university account.

Question: What does the Home page show?
Answer: Home has the top bar (navigation), the side bar (your pending tasks and questions), and the Class Panel listing today's and the upcoming week's classes.

Question: How do I jump to Courses or my Schedule?
Answer: Use the top bar — it links to Home, Courses, Schedule, Tasks, and Forum from any page.

Question: How will I know a class is starting?
Answer: The system pops up a notification when a class is about to start; tap 'Join Class' from the notification to enter on time.

Question: What's in the side bar on Home?
Answer: Pending Questions, Pre-Class Material to do before class, Due Assignments, and a Submission Bar showing how many tasks are left versus completed (completed shown in orange).

Question: What is Pending Question?
Answer: It lists questions you asked in class that are still waiting for a reply from the instructor.

Question: What's the Pre-Class Material section for?
Answer: It guides you through activities you should finish before the class begins, in the recommended order.

Question: How does Due Assignment work?
Answer: It shows assignments with upcoming deadlines and takes you straight to whatever's still incomplete by default.

Question: What does the Submission Bar mean?
Answer: It shows the total number of pending tasks; tasks already submitted are highlighted in orange.

Question: What's the Class Panel?
Answer: It lists every class scheduled for today plus the rest of this week (Monday–Saturday), sorted by start time.

Question: How do I enter a live class?
Answer: From the Class Panel, click 'Enter Class' on the matching session — it takes you into the live class room.

Question: How do I find a specific course?
Answer: Open Courses, pick the semester from the top bar, then click the course card. Each card shows your completion progress.

Question: Can I see how much of a course I've finished?
Answer: Yes — each course card shows total sessions and your progress through them.

Question: What's the difference between Pre-Class
Answer: In-Class
column6: Pre-Class lists what to do before the session, In-Class is for activities during the session, and Post-Class lists work to do after class ends.

Question: Can I download lecture material?
Answer: Yes — use the Download button on a unit. Only text-based files and PDFs are supported.

Question: What does 'Mark as Complete' do?
Answer: Tap it once you've finished a Pre-Class or Post-Class activity to record your progress.

Question: What is Buddi AI?
Answer: It's an in-class AI assistant. Tap the AI button to ask questions about the lesson, or chat to summarize material you've already covered.

Question: Can Buddi AI summarize next week's content?
Answer: No. Buddi AI only answers about lessons you've already studied or that are coming up and already opened — it can't reveal content from weeks that haven't been released yet.

Question: What's in the In-Class view?
Answer: A units bar lets you switch between Pre-Class, In-Class, and Post-Class content and do activities for the current session.

Question: What is the Mini Player?
Answer: A small live view of what the instructor is presenting. Tap it to go full-screen.

Question: What is the 'Did You Know' screen?
Answer: While the instructor is on a break the system shows knowledge tidbits — an image plus a short fact for you to read.

Question: How do I submit a Form in class?
Answer: Fill it in and press Submit. The system records your answer, then tap 'Mark as Complete' to confirm the activity is done.

Question: Where do I see assignment details?
Answer: Each assignment shows its title, release date, due date, points, and number of questions in its detail view.

Question: How do Polls work?
Answer: A poll question appears — pick an answer and submit to share your response.

Question: What are Linkage Tools?
Answer: External links or resources the instructor adds for the lesson. Click one to open the related site or learning material.

Question: What can I do in a Breakout Room?
Answer: See your group via the Member tab and chat with members (or Buddi AI) via the Chat tab while you work together.

Question: Can I talk to Buddi AI inside a breakout?
Answer: Yes — the breakout's Chat tab supports messaging the group and chatting with Buddi AI.

Question: How do group assignments work?
Answer: Open the group activity bar to see submission history and group members. Use 'View Assignment' to review or submit your work.

Question: Where can I see group assignment details?
Answer: The Group Assignment info bar shows the title, due date, description, and submission status.

Question: Can I see my group's past submissions?
Answer: Yes — the group activity detail bar shows your group's submission history and member list.

Question: How do I view my class schedule?
Answer: Open Schedule. Today's classes are highlighted; hover over a class to get a quick menu for joining.

Question: Can I switch between weekly and monthly view?
Answer: Yes — use the Week/Month toggle to change the schedule view.

Question: What's in the Tasks page?
Answer: All your Pending Questions waiting for answers, every overdue or upcoming Due Assignment, and all recommended Pre-Class Material in one place.

Question: How do I start a forum topic?
Answer: On Forum, click Create and choose a topic or course relevant to the question or discussion.

Question: How do I find a topic in Forum?
Answer: Use the Forum filters to narrow the list down to topics that match what you're looking for.
